scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && concurrently -n api,admin -c green,gray "npm run dev -w @nexo/api" "npm run dev -w @nexo/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexo/ui && npm run build -w @nexo/admin
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run deploy:staging -w @nexo/api
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run deploy:production -w @nexo/api
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/smoke-catalog.mjs && node scripts/smoke-pos.mjs
